scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

apps.access_detail: Integration token or OAuth; user grants access to specific workspace content.
apps.surface: REST; pages, blocks, data sources and search
apps.note: Access is limited to shared resources; MCP user authorization does not imply workspace-wide access.
apps.workflow: Read a specifically shared Notion page
apps.next_action: Confirm Notion integration availability on the intended plan, share one test page with the integration, and retrieve its blocks.
apps.success_criterion: Read the shared page while an unshared page remains inaccessible; record data-source versus page scope.
apps.alternative_action: Compare user-authorized MCP access with integration-token sharing rules rather than assuming workspace-wide visibility.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
